resources.string: Your AI chat, floating over any app.
Required so the bubble can float on top of other apps.
Shows the small \"Bubble is running\" notification with a Stop button.
The bubble is running. Tap it to chat; drag it to move.
Sign in by creating a link in the web app (sidebar → Link bubble app) and opening it on this phone.
Account link received. Open the bubble to finish signing in.
That link looks incomplete. Create a new one in the web app.
Some phones stop background apps to save battery, which closes the bubble.
Battery optimization is off for Bubble Chat.
On Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, Realme or OnePlus, also open Settings → Apps → Bubble Chat and turn on Autostart and \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\" (names vary by phone).
Keeps the chat bubble available over other apps.
Chat is starting up. Try again in a moment.
Android pauses apps you haven\'t opened for a few months, which would stop the bubble. Turn off "Pause app activity if unused".
